list.text: Lake of Rage\nAlso Known As GYARADOS Lake
The GYARADOS are angry!\nIt's a bad omen!
Did my eyes deceive me? I saw a red GYARADOS in the Lake of Rage...
But I thought GYARADOS were usually blue?
I heard this lake was made by rampaging GYARADOS.
I wonder if there is any connection to their mass outbreak now?

list.ruby:
pkmn = Pokemon.new(:GYARADOS, 30)
pkmn.shiny = true
pkmn.learn_move(:BITE)
pkmn.learn_move(:DRAGONRAGE)
pkmn.learn_move(:TWISTER)
pkmn.learn_move(:LEER)
WildBattle.start(pkmn)

list.text: \f[lance]\bThat red GYARADOS wasn't acting right. As I feared, somebody must have forced it to evolve...
\f[lance]\bDid you come here because of the wild tales?
\f[lance]\bI heard some rumblings, so I came to investigate...
\f[lance]\bI saw the way you battled earlier, \PN.
\f[lance]\bI can tell that you're a Trainer with considerable skill.
\f[lance]\bIf you don't mind, could you help me investigate?

branches.text: \f[lance]\bIt seems that the Lake of Rage's MAGIKARP are being forced to evolve.
\f[lance]\bA misterious radio broadcast coming from Mahogany is probably the cause.
\f[lance]\bI'll be waiting for you in Mahogany, \PN!
\f[lance]\bOh... Well, if you change your mind, please help me.
